title: The Four Wars and the Four Salvations
description: Two paired four-fold treatments of the same redemptive arc, viewed as conflict and as deliverance. The Four Wars are fought by First Man (descent into proprium), Living Spirit (structuring/binding), Third Ambassador (revealing icon), and Jesus the Radiance (glorifying). The Four (and a fifth) Salvations recapitulate this as discrete stages of releasing captive Light: First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, and the Great Counsel as Call-with-Hearing gathering souls into the Panaretos.
